text: This is Customs Officer Ramesh Iyer from Mumbai International Airport. A parcel booked using your PAN card contains a banned substance and has been seized under the Customs Act 1962. Non-cooperation will lead to prosecution and seizure of your bank accounts.
To close this customs case, we are emailing you a copy of the seizure memo and officer ID card. Reply confirming receipt so the case number can be linked to your Aadhaar for verification.
The customs case against your parcel must be resolved within 45 minutes or it will be escalated to the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence and a lookout notice will be issued in your name.
Income Tax Department Intimation: Your refund of Rs 18,540 is on hold pending video-KYC verification. An officer will join a video call shortly; please have your PAN and Aadhaar visible on camera.
Failure to complete video-KYC within 20 minutes will result in your PAN being flagged for tax evasion under Section 276C and your refund being permanently forfeited.

This video-KYC session is confidential tax department business. Do not put the call on speaker or let anyone else in the room listen, as unauthorized disclosure of tax proceedings is itself an offence.
Dear customer, your SIM card KYC is incomplete as per TRAI guidelines and will be permanently blocked within 2 hours. Press 1 now to connect to a customer care executive to update your KYC.
To complete SIM verification, download the AnyDesk app from the Play Store and share the 9-digit code shown on your screen with our verification executive.
If your SIM is blocked due to incomplete KYC, your linked bank accounts and UPI apps will also stop working immediately, and reactivation may take up to 30 days.

Dear consumer, your electricity bill has not been updated in our system. Your power supply will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM. Contact our billing officer immediately on this number to avoid disconnection.
To stop the disconnection, install the QuickSupport remote app so our officer can directly update your meter reading and process the pending payment from your side.
SBI Alert: Your account KYC will expire today. Update immediately via the secure link below to avoid your account being frozen within 24 hours.
Click the link and log in with your net-banking credentials and card details to verify your identity and complete the KYC re-validation process instantly.
Microsoft Security Alert: We have detected a serious virus on your computer that is stealing your bank details right now. Do not turn off your computer.
Please download AnyDesk immediately and share the ID displayed on your screen so our certified technician can remotely remove the virus before it accesses your banking apps.
This virus is actively spreading to other files on your system. Every minute you delay increases the risk of permanent data loss, so please connect the technician right away.
Congratulations, you have been shortlisted for a work-from-home data entry job paying Rs 25,000/month. Pay a refundable registration fee of Rs 499 to receive your offer letter and starter kit.
Since you have already paid the registration fee, you now need to pay a one-time training and software access fee of Rs 1,999 to unlock your first batch of paid tasks.
Your account balance shows Rs 8,400 in earned task rewards, but you must pay a Rs 2,500 withdrawal activation fee within the next hour or your accumulated earnings will be forfeited.
Our SEBI-registered analyst is sharing today's guaranteed intraday tips in a private Telegram group. Only 12 seats remain for new members joining this batch.
You've already invested Rs 20,000 and your dashboard shows Rs 34,000 in profit. To withdraw, you must first pay a 15% tax clearance fee as required by the exchange.
Our platform is registered with SEBI under registration number INZ000123456. Screenshot of our registration certificate is attached for your verification.
Hello, I'm calling from City Care Hospital. Your husband met with a road accident and is in the ICU. We need Rs 40,000 deposited immediately before we can begin emergency treatment.
There isn't time to verify with anyone else right now, every minute matters for his treatment - please just transfer the deposit first and I'll explain the details once he is stable.
Hi Dad, saving this as my new number, my old phone broke and I lost all my contacts. Message me here from now on.
Dad I'm in a bit of trouble, I need to clear an urgent bill of Rs 12,000 today or I'll lose my hostel seat, can you transfer it to this account right now?
Please don't mention this to Mom yet, I don't want her to worry, I'll tell her myself once things are sorted.
LIC Policy Alert: Your policy is due to lapse today due to a pending premium of Rs 3,200. Pay immediately through the link below to avoid losing your accumulated bonus.
Our records show your last payment could not be verified. Please share your policy document and PAN card photo so we can manually verify and reinstate your policy.
This is to inform you that a legal notice has been filed against you in the Delhi High Court under case number CC/2026/4471. A copy of the summons has been sent to your email for your records.
Failure to respond to this summons within 24 hours will result in an ex-parte judgment and a warrant being issued for your arrest.
To avoid appearing in court in person, you may settle this matter directly with our legal officer over a call on this number.
RBI Notice: Your bank account has been flagged for unusual activity and will be blocked within 6 hours unless you re-verify your details.
Please install the RBI Secure Verification app from the link below and enter your account number, card number and CVV to complete re-verification.
Madam this is Constable Suresh from the traffic police station. Your son has been detained after a minor accident and we need Rs 15,000 cash to release him before the case is formally registered.
If we have to register the case formally it will take days and go on his record permanently, so it is better to settle this quietly right now, just between us.
This is a final notice from Quick Rupee Loans legal recovery cell. Your loan of Rs 5,000 is overdue and we have been authorized to contact your listed emergency contacts and employer.
Repay the outstanding amount plus penalty within 3 hours or we will proceed with legal action and publish a defaulter notice with your photo to all your contacts.
We have obtained private photos from your phone through a security gap in a app you installed last month. We are giving you a chance to resolve this privately before we act.
Send Rs 25,000 in Bitcoin to the wallet address below within 24 hours or we will send everything to your entire contact list.
Your international package is held at customs pending a duty payment of Rs 350. Complete the payment within 2 hours via the link or the package will be returned to sender.
To release the hold, open the payment link and enter your card number, expiry and CVV to clear the customs duty instantly.
I really feel a genuine connection with you after all our conversations. I haven't told my family about us yet, I want to be sure of us first before involving them.
I'm stuck at customs with my belongings and need Rs 45,000 to clear a customs fee before my flight to meet you, can you help me today, I'll pay you back the moment I land.
I am currently posted on a peacekeeping mission overseas and cannot use my personal accounts, that is why I am asking you and not my unit for this help.
The shipping company needs another Rs 18,000 in clearance fees for the gift box I sent you, after this payment there will be no more charges before it reaches you.
Hi, sorry to bother you, I accidentally sent my WhatsApp verification code to your number instead of mine, could you please forward the 6-digit code you just received?
This is WhatsApp support, we noticed a login attempt from an unrecognized device on your account, please share the verification code to help us secure it immediately.

This is Senior Intelligence Officer Meena Kapoor from the Income Tax Investigation Wing. Your PAN is linked to a Rs 2.3 crore undisclosed foreign transaction. Stay on this call and do not discuss it with anyone until we complete the verification.
We are sending the investigation order to your email right now. You must respond and clear your name within one hour or a lookout circular will be issued against you at all airports.
As a SEBI-registered research analyst, I can guarantee 40% returns in this IPO allotment. Only 5 slots remain in today's private allotment batch.
Since your initial deposit of Rs 15,000 has already been allocated to shares, you'll need to add Rs 10,000 more to meet the minimum lot size before you can withdraw any profit.
Your credit card limit upgrade to Rs 5,00,000 is approved. Pay a one-time processing fee of Rs 1,499 through the secure link to activate the new limit instantly.
This offer from our card services department is valid only until midnight today, after which the approved upgrade will be automatically cancelled.
Ayushman Bharat Notice: Your health insurance claim of Rs 40,000 requires document verification. Share a photo of your Aadhaar, ration card and bank passbook to process your claim.
For faster processing, please switch this conversation to WhatsApp video call so our verification officer can confirm your identity directly.

This is Sub-Registrar office calling regarding a property registered in your late father's name. There is a pending stamp duty penalty that must be cleared to avoid the property being seized by the state.
This matter must be resolved before the family finds out and complicates the inheritance process, please handle the pending payment directly with our office today.
You have been selected under the PM Kisan Samman Yojana for an additional grant of Rs 50,000. Pay a one-time registration fee of Rs 799 to process your grant disbursal.
This scheme registration window, verified by the Ministry portal, closes tonight. Delayed registration will forfeit your selected grant permanently.
This is the Fraud Prevention Department of HDFC Bank. We've detected an unauthorized transaction attempt of Rs 82,000 on your account and need to verify your identity to block it.
To block the fraudulent transaction, please open your banking app now and read out the OTP sent to you so we can confirm it is really you and stop the transfer.
Please do not hang up or contact the branch directly while we are actively blocking this transaction, doing so may cause the fraud to go through instead.
Your Flipkart return has been approved for a refund of Rs 3,200. Accept the payment request on your UPI app and enter your UPI PIN to receive the amount instantly.
This refund request will expire in 10 minutes and cannot be reissued, please accept and confirm right away.
Hi, this is regarding the flat you enquired about. Another family is ready to book it today, but I can hold it for you if you send the token amount of Rs 5,000 right now.
Once you send the token amount via UPI, I'll share the agreement copy and the keys can be handed over this weekend.
Your FASTag KYC is pending and your tag will be deactivated today. Click the link and complete KYC using your bank details to keep using the FASTag lane without interruption.
I am an army Major currently posted at the border, I sell canteen goods at a discount to civilians through this scheme, you can trust me as a fellow patriot.
Transfer the balance payment for the goods first, since army protocol requires full payment before dispatch from the canteen store.
Hey, it's been years! It's Rohit from St. Xavier's, remember me? I got your number from a mutual friend, so good to reconnect after all this time.
I'm actually in a tight spot right now, my wallet got stolen while traveling and I just need Rs 6,000 to get through the next two days, I'll return it the moment I'm back home.
This is Priya from HR. Payroll is migrating to a new bank verification system today and your salary account details need to be re-confirmed or your next salary credit will be delayed.
Please click the link and log in with your net-banking credentials to re-link your salary account before the payroll cut-off at 5 PM today.
Beta, it's your uncle from Pune, your aunty is in the hospital and we're short on cash at the counter right now, can you send Rs 20,000 to this account immediately, I'll explain everything later.
Please keep this between us for now, your aunty gets anxious when too many people know she's unwell, we'll tell the rest of the family once she's stable.
Hi, this is Anjali from your college WhatsApp group, we're collecting a small contribution for a classmate's emergency surgery, could you chip in whatever you can on this UPI ID?
You were one of the first people I thought of since you've always been so generous, even Rs 500 would mean a lot to the family right now.
